name: Kevin Woodward
original_name: ケビン・ウッドワード
source:
A guest who lives in Room 219 (Bravery). He is the father of [url=/c149569]Melissa[/url] and husband of Grace. 

[Spoiler]His conflict is centered around his wife's disappearance and the struggle to connect with his daughter. He came to Hotel Dusk to look for his wife.[/spoiler]

[Based on the [url=https://cing.fandom.com/wiki/Kevin_Woodward]wiki[/url]]
